blocks.text: [ PASSOFF- principle02]
Principle 2: Family Introduction
Thank you for the chance to tell you about my family.
Thank you for this opportunity to introduce my family.
I have a nice family.
There are 4 people in my family: my father, my mother,my sister, and
myself.
Someday, I would like to have one more brother or sister.
My father works very hard at a small cell phone company.
He has worked there for almost ten years.
I think he is the hardest worker in his company.
My mother is a housewife.
She had worked at a department store for several years.
She is the best mother in the world. I really love my mother and father.
My parents always make my sister and I feel important and special.
My parents love each other.
They always have been a good example for us.
My father is always helpful around the house.
He often goes shopping with my mother. I look up to him.
My mother is a very good cook, and is still a beautiful woman.
She looks younger than her age. I love my mother.
My sister attends Han-guk Elementary School.
She is good at playing the piano,
and she is good at studying all kinds of subjects.
I want her to be a good pianist. She is more talented than me.
My sister likes all kinds of animals. In fact, she has a dog.
She also loves to listen to music and talk to her friends on the phone.
She is more talkative than my mother.
My family is always happy, and we are very close to one another,
which helps me really understand the importance of family.
